mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 62 degrees with overcast skies along the Military Ridge State Trail. Later tonight, look to the skies starting at 7:37 PM for an ISS flyover, rising in the West Northwest over Cross Plains and heading toward the Northeast near Madison.

The City of Verona has launched an eighteen month effort to update the 2026 Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long term guide for our growth. You can track progress and find meeting notices at the Envision Verona website. Also, don't forget to subscribe to the city newsletter for the latest on local programs and projects.

Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness or head to Hop Haus for trivia. Tomorrow, catch live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival kicks off in Paoli this Friday.

In our weekly report, on September 5, officers responded to reports of vehicles being targeted by a viral social media prank where cheese slices were placed on windshields, though no damage was reported.
Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, but they will be ready to serve you when the doors open today at 10:00 AM.
